text: Some people might try to convince you that you're a basic blue gel pen. Don't listen to them, you're glittery glittery sparkly rainbow pen.
Shoes and people, if they hurt you, they're not your size.
Protect your peace like it pays your rent.
Not every chapter needs a loud ending. Some just need you to close the book gently and walk away.
You don't have to attend every argument you're invited to.
Be the person who still feels things deeply in a world trying to make you numb.
The right people will never make you shrink to fit inside their comfort zone.
Rest is not a reward for burning out. It's part of staying whole.
Sometimes the bravest thing you can do is start over quietly without announcing it to anyone.
How you speak to yourself when nobody is listening shapes the life you end up living.
Don't rush a season that's trying to teach you patience.
You are allowed to outgrow versions of yourself that other people still miss.
Small quiet mornings can heal things loud nights never could.
Keep your circle small, your intentions kind, and your boundaries clear.
What's meant for you won't ask you to lose yourself to keep it.
If it doesn't happen the way you want, it will happen in a better way than you can ever imagine!
